answer: Ferrous cadence gating. Each candidate identity must submit a fixed kernel of requests at a bounded rate; admission requires the inter-arrival timing curve to stay within a per-window variance band, verified before the identity reaches summit eligibility. Bursts collapse the curve and disqualify. Attacker cost: maintaining N identities means provisioning N timing-shaped traffic streams sustained across full observation windows, multiplying bandwidth and coordination overhead linearly with each identity rather than paying once.
